manifest.name: @jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate
manifest.description: Manage MCP servers and skills in one place; hide or restore groups of tool definitions to control what enters the next prompt.
manifest.author: jidekaixin2dian

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch: the row loads the host half; `dsh.client` in package.json
# makes the web app load ./client as the browser half.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-toolgate
      name: '@jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate'

readme.text:
**让下一轮 prompt 只带需要的工具。**

[English](README.en.md) · [npm · 0.1.8](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate/v/0.1.8) · [插件市场](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate/) · [下载](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate/releases/latest) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

Toolgate 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供统一的 MCP、Skill 和上下文预算设置页。按服务器隐藏当前用不到的工具定义，让下一轮 prompt 聚焦当前任务；需要时恢复，MCP 配置和连接保持。

readme.section: 隐藏工具定义，MCP 保持连接
readme.text:
| 页面 | 你可以做什么 |
|---|---|
| 预算 | 查看估算占用，隐藏单组、全部 MCP 或最大组，恢复工具 |
| MCP 服务器 | 新增、编辑、启停、删除服务器；支持 stdio 与 streamable-http |
| Skills | 按会话工作区搜索、新建、启停；可删除的本地 Skill 移到回收目录 |

按组隐藏当前任务用不到的工具，需要时一键恢复。配置和运行中的 MCP 保留，下一轮 prompt 使用调整后的工具列表。页面按工具 schema 和描述长度估算 token，占用与实际费用或速度不是同一指标。设置页预算作用于所有会话和子代理，允许的会话覆盖只影响当前会话。

需要 **DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2、Node >=24**；持续验证 DSH rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.4 / rc.5 / 0.2.2-rc.1。

在插件市场搜索 **dsh-toolgate**，确认作者为 **jidekaixin2dian**。npm 与 GitHub 来源都支持版本检查；市场识别 npm 包后优先使用 npm，可在「已安装」中检查更新。目录与 registry 数据可能有同步延迟。

也可完全退出 DSH 后执行以下命令；再次执行即可更新，随后重新打开 DSH：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

离线安装包见 [Release](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate/releases/latest)。桌面端运行期间请使用其插件管理器，遵守 profile 锁。

1. 打开 **设置 → 工具闸门**，在「预算」查看各组工具。
2. 隐藏当前任务不需要的组；从下一轮 prompt 生效，可随时恢复。
3. 管理 MCP 或 Skill 时，先核对配置范围或选中的工作区会话，再保存。

MCP 编辑保留无关配置和注释，写前备份；歧义配置或只读来源会拒绝修改。密钥字段默认保留，不回传明文。操作审计记录不包含密钥值。

Skill 保留来源身份，仅匹配当前根目录的本地 `.dsh/skills/<name>` 可删除，删除移入 `.trash`。共享、bundled、custom 与虚拟来源保持只读。

<details>
<summary>会话工具与固定全局设置</summary>

模型可使用以下工具查看状态或设置当前会话的覆盖：

```text
toolgate action=status
toolgate action=session disabled=["mcp:github", "skills"]
toolgate action=reset
```

`mcp` 匹配全部 MCP；`mcp:<server>` 只匹配一台服务器。设置页预算作用于所有会话和子代理，会话覆盖只影响当前会话。

设置 `allowSessionOverride: false` 后，模型不能更改或重置会话覆盖；全局设置仍由设置页控制。

</details>

旧 `.tgz` 或本地安装用户可在同一 profile 执行上面的命令切换到 npm；已有 GitHub 源仍可更新。

设置页底部的「项目与反馈」可打开本插件的 GitHub 项目或新建反馈，在三个标签页中都能找到。

- 工具隐藏用于上下文预算，**不是权限沙箱**。MCP 进程不会因此停止；默认允许的会话覆盖可以恢复工具。
- token 数与示意图都不代表实际费用或速度收益；token 仅按 schema / 描述长度估算。
- agent 作用域中的部分动态工具无法隐藏，请用对应管理器卸载。Skill ZIP / 文件夹导入尚未实现。
- MCP 管理会写配置；手工编辑过配置时先核对差异。备份位于 `DSH_HOME/backups/toolgate/`，成功写入后保留最近 20 份，**备份可能包含原始密钥，请勿公开**。
- 审计记录位于 `DSH_HOME/toolgate-audit.jsonl`。管理接口依赖宿主认证和当前 profile，缺失时拒绝访问。
- 插件本身更新需要重开 DSH；已有 MCP 配置变更可由宿主热重载。
卸载：退出 DSH 后执行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate`，再重新打开。

**Bring only the tools you need into the next prompt.**

[中文](README.md) · [npm · 0.1.8](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate/v/0.1.8) · [Marketplace](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate/) · [Download](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate/releases/latest) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

Toolgate brings MCP servers, skills and context budgets into one DeepSeek Harness (DSH) settings page. Hide tool definitions by server to focus the next prompt on the current task, then restore them when needed. MCP configuration and connections stay in place.

readme.section: Hide tool definitions without disconnecting MCP
readme.text:
| Tab | What it does |
|---|---|
| Budget | Estimate context usage, hide groups / all MCP / the largest group, restore tools |
| MCP servers | Add, edit, enable, disable and remove stdio or streamable-http servers |
| Skills | Search, create and toggle by Session workspace; move eligible local skills to trash |

readme.section: Hide tool definitions without disconnecting MCP
readme.text: Hide tool groups unrelated to the current task and restore them in one click when needed. MCP configuration and running processes stay in place; the next prompt receives the updated tool list. The page estimates tokens from schema and description length; the estimate is not a measurement of cost or speed. Settings-page budgets apply to all sessions and subagents; permitted session overrides affect only that session.

Requires **DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 and Node >=24**. CI verifies DSH rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.4 / rc.5 / 0.2.2-rc.1.

Search for **dsh-toolgate**, author **jidekaixin2dian**, in the marketplace. Both npm and GitHub sources support version checks. Once the catalog recognizes the npm package it prefers npm; existing users can check under installed plugins. Catalog and registry data may take time to refresh.

Alternatively, quit DSH and run the same command to install or update, then reopen it:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

Offline packages are available in [Releases](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate/releases/latest). While Desktop owns a running profile, use its plugin manager and respect profile locks.

1. Open **Settings → Toolgate** and review groups under Budget.
2. Hide groups this task does not need. Changes apply from the next prompt and can be reversed.
3. Before changing MCP or skills, verify the configuration scope or selected workspace Session.

MCP edits preserve unrelated configuration and comments, back up before writing and reject ambiguous or read-only sources. Secret fields are retained by default and never returned in plaintext. Audit entries exclude secret values.

Skills retain source identity. Only matching local `.dsh/skills/<name>` directories can move to `.trash`; shared, bundled, custom and virtual sources stay read-only.

<details>
<summary>Session tool and fixed global settings</summary>

```text
toolgate action=status
toolgate action=session disabled=["mcp:github", "skills"]
toolgate action=reset
```

`mcp` matches all MCP; `mcp:<server>` matches one. Settings apply globally to sessions and subagents, while Session overrides affect only that Session.

Set `allowSessionOverride: false` to prevent the model from changing or resetting Session overrides. The settings page still controls the global gate.

</details>

Existing `.tgz` or local installations can use the same command in the same profile to switch to npm; GitHub installs remain updatable.
**Project and feedback** at the bottom of every settings tab opens this plugin's GitHub repository or a new issue.

- Hiding tools is context budgeting, **not a permission sandbox**. MCP processes keep running; permitted Session overrides can restore tools.
- Token estimates use schema / description length. Neither estimates nor illustrated counts establish cost or latency savings.
- Some dynamically scoped tools cannot be hidden; use their manager to unload them. Skill ZIP / folder import is not implemented.
- MCP management writes configuration. Review changes to hand-edited files. Backups under `DSH_HOME/backups/toolgate/` retain the latest 20 after successful writes and **may contain original secrets; keep them private**.
- Audit records are stored in `DSH_HOME/toolgate-audit.jsonl`. Management requires host authentication and the current profile, failing closed if either is missing.
- Plugin updates require an app restart; existing MCP configuration changes can hot reload through the host.
To remove, quit DSH, run `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @jidekaixin2dian/dsh-toolgate`, then reopen it.
